popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Nycteus Theban king and father of Antiope — the regent whose daughter Zeus takes as a satyr, and whose death passes the throne to Lycus.

popCulture.title: Nycteus
popCulture.description: King of Thebes, father of Antiope and Nycteis — the Cadmean house before Amphion and Zethus reclaim the city.

popCulture.title: Antiope (mother of Amphion)
popCulture.description: Nycteus' daughter by Zeus — mother of Amphion and Zethus, whose rescue and return avenge the Theban house.

popCulture.title: Lycus of Thebes
popCulture.description: Nycteus' brother (or kinsman) who inherits the regency and mistreats Antiope — the tyrant Amphion and Zethus overthrow.
